description: Roleplaying: Children control the train's speed, whistle, and cargo, acting as the driver. Interactivity: The game features a steam train with levers to pull, buttons to push, and sparks/smoke effects. Cargo & Passengers: Users can load/unload characters and cargo, with visual cues indicating where to stop. Scenery: The game includes6 different stations. Perspectives: Players can experience the game from the conductor's seat or from various outside perspectives. Child-Friendly: No third-party advertising or in-app purchases.
